storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/drought/ (gz after 2 days)
written_by: server/droughtMonitor.ts archiveDrought (24h poll over a 70-day window, eager boot)
source: US Drought Monitor data services (usdmdataservices.unl.edu) — CONUS + 8 ag/water states by FIPS (probed: state abbreviations return empty)
license: Free for any use WITH REQUIRED CREDIT: 'U.S. Drought Monitor (NDMC/USDA/NOAA)' — produced jointly by the National Drought Mitigation Center, USDA, and NOAA

field_map.aoi + map_date: dedup key — maps are weekly (Tuesday data) and final on publish
field_map.d0..d4: CUMULATIVE area % per USDM convention (D0 includes everything drier)
field_map.dsci: DERIVED: d0+d1+d2+d3+d4 — the published Drought Severity and Coverage Index (0-500)

confidence_model: RAW official weekly designations (one DERIVED index, labeled, using the USDM's own published formula). Rows with any malformed percentage are dropped whole — a partial severity row would corrupt the DSCI. One-AOI failures survive the poll; only all-AOI failure throws.
geo_fields: (aoi -> CONUS or state; polygon detail not archived — the USDM shapefile layer is a filed follow-up if map display is wanted)
cadence: weekly source (Thursday release), 24h poll (dedup makes off-days a no-op)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). BUILD ORDER 2 #5; hypothesis (belt drought deltas lead ag commodities and food-producer margins) stays gate-locked — archive + RAW display only.
